scope: Identify simulation/model numerical cause before production edits or new training. No FPS benchmark or 830xx use.

fixed.flat_proxy_assets: original current robot and Field USD

probe_validity: same reset initial conditions and asset/source hash; explicitly distinguish treatment settling effects
native same-slot qd and actual effort capture every physics iteration
PD effort formula consistent with qd/target/I; clipping only at cap
all finite; native torque never exceeds 2Nm+1e-5; expected callback counts
do not interpret unsupported contact route or diagnostic script errors as physical results

decision.timestep_convergence: Compare final 1s body yaw mean for 2ms vs1ms; require abs difference <=max(0.01 rad/s,10% of finer value) before treating 2ms as resolved. If not converged, diagnose further or add 0.5ms case; no silent threshold relaxation.
decision.if_weak_after_timestep_convergence: At fixed mu/assets/control, compare elliptic friction cone and tangential constraint impedance using official solver parameters. Do not tune mu to force nominal no-slip yaw.
decision.physical_validation_after_candidate: Forward/reverse, both turn directions, low/high differential, arcs and zero-command braking, plus rough-terrain/regression checks before new initialization training. Compare actual pose and substep torque; no hand-written body velocity servo.
decision.claim_limit: No-slip yaw is a diagnostic reference, not calibrated real tank yaw. Passing numerical and software checks does not prove real-car calibration or navigation ability.
